items.en: This question was easy, so I knew the answer at once.

wrong.why: むずかしい is difficult. A difficult question is not answered at once.
ながい is long. A long question takes longer, not less time.
おもい is heavy. A question has no weight.

items.note: This asks why the answer came at once: the question was やさしい, easy.
items.sentence: この もんだいは （　）ですから、すぐ こたえが わかりました。

items.en: This is a library, so please talk quietly.

wrong.why: にぎやか is lively and noisy: the opposite of what a library wants.
げんきに is cheerfully. It says nothing about keeping your voice down.
じょうずに is skilfully. A library asks for quiet, not skill.

items.note: This asks how to talk in a library: しずかに, quietly.
items.sentence: ここは としょかんですから、（　） はなして ください。

items.en: Three sheets of this paper, please.

wrong.why: ほん counts long, thin things: pencils, bottles.
こ counts small round things: apples, eggs.
さつ counts books and notebooks.

items.note: This asks the counter for flat things such as paper: まい. 3まい is read さんまい.
items.sentence: この かみを 3（　） ください。

items.en: My older brother is three years older than me.

wrong.why: した would make him younger. An older brother, あに, is older: うえ.
まえ is in front, or before. Ages are compared with うえ and した.
あと is after, for time. Ages are compared with うえ and した.

items.note: This asks how ages compare. An older brother, あに, is older than you: 3さい うえ.
items.sentence: あには わたしより 3さい （　）です。

items.en: My room is on the second floor. Go up the stairs; it's the room on the right.

wrong.why: ろうか is a corridor. It is flat: you walk along it, not up it.
げんかん is the entrance hall, at the bottom, where you take off your shoes.
だいどころ is the kitchen: a room, not a way up.

items.note: This asks how you go up to the second floor: you climb the かいだん, the stairs.
items.sentence: わたしの へやは 2かいです。（　）を あがって、みぎの へやです。

items.en: It takes an hour to walk to the station. That's a long way, isn't it?

wrong.why: ちかい is near. An hour on foot is far.
はやい is fast or early. Distance is とおい or ちかい.
おそい is slow or late. Distance is とおい or ちかい.

items.note: This asks what an hour's walk to the station means: the station is とおい, far.
items.sentence: えきまで あるいて 1じかん かかります。とても （　）ですね。

items.en: A: Have you had lunch? B: No, not yet.

wrong.why: もう goes with something already done: もう たべました. After いいえ and たべて いません, it is まだ.
すぐ is right away. It does not go with たべて いません.
ちょうど is just or exactly. It does not go with a 'not yet' answer.

items.note: This asks what fits 'No, not yet': まだ. まだ 〜て いません is something that has not happened yet.
items.sentence:
A「ひるごはんは たべましたか。」
B「いいえ、（　） たべて いません。」

items.en: Please take this medicine after you eat.

wrong.why: まえ takes the plain form: たべる まえに. たべた, the past, goes with あと.
よこ is beside: a place, not a time.
なか is inside: a place, not a time.

items.note: This asks when to take the medicine: after eating, たべた あとに.
items.sentence: この くすりは ごはんを たべた （　）に のんで ください。

items.en: I brush my teeth every morning.
items.note: This asks what you do to your teeth every morning: みがきます, brush them.
items.sentence: まいあさ はを （　）。

items.en: I take the train to work.
items.note: This asks what you ride to work: でんしゃ, a train. のる is for getting on things that carry you.
items.sentence: （　）に のって、かいしゃへ いきます。

items.en: I caught a cold and have been in bed since yesterday.

wrong.why: せき is a cough. A cough comes with が でる, not ひく.
みみ is an ear. You cannot ひく an ear.
こえ is a voice. You cannot ひく a voice.

items.note: This asks what you catch and stay in bed with: a cold, かぜを ひく.
items.sentence: （　）を ひいて、きのうから ねて います。

items.en: The restaurant's menu has curry and ramen.
items.note: This asks where a restaurant lists its food: the メニュー, the menu.
items.sentence: レストランの （　）には カレーと ラーメンが あります。

items.en: I rubbed out the wrong letters with an eraser.
items.note: This asks what you rub out letters with: a けしゴム, an eraser.
items.sentence: （　）で まちがえた じを けしました。

items.en: We all sang songs at the party.
items.note: This asks what you do with a song: うたう, sing it.
items.sentence: パーティーで みんなで うたを （　）。

items.en: I bought new shoes at the department store.
items.note: This asks what you do with shoes at a department store: かいました, bought them.
items.sentence: デパートで あたらしい くつを （　）。

items.en: I put sugar in my coffee every morning.

wrong.why: だす takes something out. Sugar goes in: いれる.
あける opens something, such as a door or a box.
きる cuts, with a knife or scissors.

items.note: This asks what you do with sugar and coffee: you put it in, コーヒーに いれる.
items.sentence: わたしは まいあさ コーヒーに さとうを （　）。

items.en: I borrowed a dictionary from a friend.

wrong.why: かす is to lend. ともだちから says the dictionary came to you: かりる, borrow.
あげる is to give something away. ともだちから says it came to you.
おしえる is to teach. You cannot teach a dictionary.

items.note: This asks which way the dictionary went: from your friend to you, so you borrowed it, かりました.
items.sentence: わたしは ともだちから じしょを （　）。

items.en: This water is dirty, so please don't drink it.

wrong.why: きれい is clean. Clean water is no reason not to drink.
つめたい is cold. Cold water is fine to drink.
あたたかい is warm. Warm water is fine to drink.

items.note: This asks why you should not drink the water: it is きたない, dirty.
items.sentence: この みずは （　）ですから、のまないで ください。

items.en: This room has no windows, so it is dark.

wrong.why: あかるい is bright. A room with no windows is dark.
あたらしい is new. Windows do not make a room new or old.
ひろい is spacious. Windows do not make a room big or small.

items.note: This asks what a room without windows is like: くらい, dark.
items.sentence: この へやは まどが なくて、（　）です。

items.en: There is no school on Sundays.

wrong.why: しごと is work. A school on Sunday is closed: やすみ.
じゅぎょう is a lesson. A school is not a lesson.
しゅくだい is homework. A school is not homework.

items.note: This asks what a school is on Sunday: やすみ, closed.
items.sentence: にちようびは がっこうが （　）です。

items.en: Before getting on the train, I buy a ticket at the station.

wrong.why: きって is a stamp, for a letter. A train needs a きっぷ.
ちず is a map. You do not need one to get on a train.
かさ is an umbrella. It has nothing to do with getting on a train.

items.note: This asks what you buy at the station to ride a train: a きっぷ, a ticket. きって, with one letter different, is a stamp.
items.sentence: でんしゃに のる まえに、えきで （　）を かいます。

items.en: The bus didn't come, so I walked to the station.

wrong.why: There was no bus to get on. Without one, you go on foot.
まつ is to wait. えきまで says you went to the station.
かえる is to go home, not to the station.

items.note: This asks how you got to the station when the bus did not come: on foot, あるきました.
items.sentence: バスが きませんでしたから、えきまで （　）。

items.en: This camera was 50,000 yen. That's expensive.

wrong.why: やすい is cheap. 50,000 yen is a lot for a camera.
ひくい is low, for height. A price is たかい or やすい.
ながい is long. The sentence is about the price.

items.note: This asks what 50,000 yen for a camera is: たかい, expensive. たかい is used for prices as well as height.
items.sentence: この カメラは 5まんえんでした。（　）ですね。

items.en: I sleep seven hours every day.

wrong.why: おきる is to get up, which takes a moment, not seven hours.
あう is to meet someone, and needs a person: ともだちに あう.
つく is to arrive, which takes a moment, not seven hours.

items.note: This asks what you do for seven hours every day: ねます, sleep.
items.sentence: わたしは まいにち 7じかん （　）。

items.en: I came to Japan last year. I have been in Japan for a year now.

wrong.why: らいねん is next year, still to come. きました is past.
あした is tomorrow, still to come. きました is past.
らいしゅう is next week, still to come. きました is past.

items.note: This asks when you came to Japan. きました is past, and you have been here a year, so it was きょねん, last year.
items.sentence: （　）、わたしは にほんへ きました。いま にほんに 1ねん います。

items.en: This book is difficult, so let's read it slowly.

wrong.why: はやく is quickly. A hard book is read slowly.
まっすぐ is straight, for going along a road.
きれいに is neatly or prettily, for writing or tidying, not reading.

items.note: This asks how to read a difficult book: ゆっくり, slowly.
items.sentence: この ほんは むずかしいですから、（　） よみましょう。

items.en: This soup is hot, so please drink it slowly.
items.note: This asks why you drink the soup slowly: it is あつい, hot. さむい and すずしい are for the weather.
items.sentence: この スープは （　）ですから、ゆっくり のんで ください。

items.en: I'm hungry, so let's eat.
items.note: This asks what is empty when you want to eat: おなかが すく, to be hungry.
items.sentence: （　）が すきましたから、ごはんを たべましょう。

items.en: My favourite fruit is the apple.
items.note: This asks what kind of thing an apple is: a くだもの, a fruit.
items.sentence: わたしの すきな （　）は りんごです。

items.en: This road has a lot of cars, so it is dangerous.
items.note: This asks what a road with many cars is: あぶない, dangerous.
items.sentence: この みちは くるまが おおいですから、（　）です。

items.en: I spread butter on my bread and eat it.
items.note: This asks what you do with butter on bread: ぬる, spread it.
items.sentence: パンに バターを （　） たべます。

items.en: I'm tired, so let's rest a little.
items.note: This asks what to do when you are tired: やすむ, rest.
items.sentence: つかれましたから、すこし （　）。

items.en: This film is really interesting, so I want to see it again.

wrong.why: つまらない is dull. Nobody wants to see a dull film again.
ながい is long. Length is no reason to see a film again.
うるさい is noisy. That is no reason to see a film again.

items.note: This asks why you want to see the film again: it is おもしろい, interesting.
items.sentence: この えいがは とても （　）ですから、もう いちど みたいです。

items.en: The luggage is heavy, so let's call a taxi.

wrong.why: You do not buy a taxi; you call one: よぶ.
のむ is to drink.
おしえる is to teach.

items.note: This asks what you do to get a taxi: よぶ, call one.
items.sentence: にもつが おもいですから、タクシーを （　）。

items.en: Teacher, please tell me what this word means.

wrong.why: こえ is a voice. For a word you don't know, you ask its meaning.
なまえ is a name. For a word you don't know, you ask its meaning.
うた is a song. A word has a meaning, not a song.

items.note: This asks what you ask about a word you don't know: its いみ, its meaning.
items.sentence: せんせい、この ことばの （　）を おしえて ください。

items.en: This pen has no ink. Please lend me another pen.

wrong.why: おなじ is the same. A pen with no ink is no use; you want another one.
この ペン is the one with no ink.
どの asks which. This is a request, not a question.

items.note: This asks which pen you want when yours has no ink: ほかの, another one.
items.sentence: この ペンは インクが ありません。（　） ペンを かして ください。

items.en: A: How long does it take from here to the station? B: Ten minutes by bus.

wrong.why: なんじ asks the time on a clock. かかりますか asks how long it takes.
どこ asks where. The answer, ten minutes, is a length of time.
なに asks what. かかりますか asks how long.

items.note: This asks which question word fits かかりますか, how long does it take: どのぐらい.
items.sentence:
A「ここから えきまで （　） かかりますか。」
B「バスで 10ぷんです。」

items.en: These shoes are small, so please give me bigger ones.

wrong.why: ちいさい is small, and these are already too small.
やすい is cheap. The problem is the size.
ふるい is old. The problem is the size.

items.note: This asks what shoes you want when yours are too small: おおきい, bigger ones.
items.sentence: この くつは ちいさいですから、もっと （　） くつを ください。

items.en: I like coffee, but I don't like tea very much.

wrong.why: とても goes with a positive: とても すきです. With じゃ ありません, it is あまり.
よく does not go with すきじゃ ありません.
たくさん is a lot, for amounts. It does not go with すき.

items.note: This asks which word goes with a negative: あまり 〜じゃ ありません, not very.
items.sentence: わたしは コーヒーが すきですが、こうちゃは （　） すきじゃ ありません。

items.en: A: When did you come to Japan? B: In April last year.

wrong.why: どこ asks where. The answer gives a time: last April.
だれ asks who. The answer gives a time.
どうして asks why. The answer gives a time.

items.note: This asks which question word the answer fits. B gives a time, so A asked いつ, when.
items.sentence:
A「（　） にほんへ きましたか。」
B「きょねんの 4がつです。」

items.en: My father doesn't smoke, because it's bad for your health.

wrong.why: If smoking were good for the body, it would be no reason not to smoke.
Size has nothing to do with smoking.
じょうぶ is strong or healthy. It does not fit からだに 〜です.

items.note: This asks why he does not smoke: it is からだに わるい, bad for your health.
items.sentence: ちちは たばこを すいません。からだに （　）ですから。

items.en: The children are asleep, so please talk in a quiet voice.

wrong.why: A loud voice would wake the children.
A lively voice would wake the children.
ひろい is wide, for rooms and roads, not voices.

items.note: This asks what voice to use near sleeping children: a ちいさい こえ, a quiet voice.
items.sentence: こどもが ねて いますから、（　） こえで はなして ください。

items.en: I bought three 100-yen notebooks. That was 300 yen in all.

wrong.why: Three hundred is さんびゃく, with a dakuten.
ひゃくさんえん is 103 yen.
さんぜんえん is 3,000 yen.

items.note: This asks the total: three notebooks at 100 yen is 300 yen, read さんびゃくえん.
items.sentence: 100えんの ノートを 3さつ かいました。ぜんぶで （　）でした。

items.en: It's hot, so let's turn on the air conditioner.
items.note: This asks what you turn on when it is hot: the エアコン, the air conditioner. A ストーブ is a heater, for cold days.
items.sentence: あついですから、（　）を つけましょう。

items.en: I crossed the river by boat.
items.note: This asks what you ride across a river: a ふね, a boat.
items.sentence: （　）に のって、かわを わたりました。

items.en: It's cold, so please close the door.
items.note: This asks what you close when it is cold: the ドア, the door.
items.sentence: さむいですから、（　）を しめて ください。

items.en: Birds are flying in the sky.
items.note: This asks what birds do in the sky: とぶ, fly.
items.sentence: とりが そらを （　） います。

items.en: This shop is full of people and very lively.
items.note: This asks what a place full of people is like: にぎやか, lively.
items.sentence: この みせは ひとが たくさん いて、とても （　）です。

items.en: My younger sister plays the piano every day.
items.note: This asks the verb for playing the piano: ひく.
items.sentence: いもうとは まいにち ピアノを （　）。

items.en: The bus isn't coming. I've been waiting for 30 minutes.

wrong.why: The bus is what is not coming. You have been waiting: まって いる.
You cannot have been riding a bus that has not come.
おりる is getting off. The bus has not come yet.

items.note: This asks what you have been doing for 30 minutes when the bus does not come: まって いる, waiting.
items.sentence: バスが きません。もう 30ぷん （　） います。

items.en: Every morning I read the paper, then leave home.

wrong.why: はいる is to go in. うちを, from home, goes with でる, to leave.
かえる is to go home. You read the paper at home, then leave.
つく is to arrive, and takes に, not を.

items.note: This asks what you do from home after reading the paper: うちを でる, leave home.
items.sentence: わたしは まいあさ しんぶんを よんでから、うちを （　）。

items.en: Excuse me, please tell me the way to the station.

wrong.why: ちず is a map. You ask someone the way: みち.
なまえ is a name. You ask the way to the station: みち.
くるま is a car. You ask the way: みち.

items.note: This asks what you ask for to get to the station: the みち, the way.
items.sentence: すみません、えきへ いく （　）を おしえて ください。

items.en: I slept well last night, so today I feel great.

wrong.why: ひま is having free time. Sleeping well makes you feel well, not free.
しずか is quiet. Sleeping well makes you feel well: げんき.
きれい is pretty or clean. Sleeping well makes you feel well: げんき.

items.note: This asks how you feel after a good night's sleep: げんき, well and lively.
items.sentence: ゆうべ よく ねましたから、きょうは とても （　）です。

items.en: Go straight along this road, then turn right at the next corner.

wrong.why: わたる is to cross, for a road or a bridge. At a corner you turn: まがる.
おりる is to get off, not a way to go round a corner.
のる is to get on. At a corner you turn: まがる.

items.note: This asks what you do at a corner to go right: まがる, turn.
items.sentence: この みちを まっすぐ いって、つぎの かどを みぎに （　） ください。

items.en: I'm tired, so let's sit on that chair over there.

wrong.why: まど is a window. You sit on a chair, not a window.
いけ is a pond. You cannot sit on a pond.
そら is the sky. You cannot sit on the sky.

items.note: This asks what you sit on: an いす, a chair.
items.sentence: つかれましたから、あそこの （　）に すわりましょう。

items.en: I don't really understand Japanese. Please say it once more.

wrong.why: すぐ is at once. It does not go with わかりません here.
とても goes with a positive. It does not go with わかりません.
たくさん is a lot, for amounts. It does not go with わかる.

items.note: This asks which word goes with a negative here: よく わかりません, I don't really understand.
items.sentence: わたしは にほんごが （　） わかりません。もう いちど いって ください。

items.en: My sister is three years older than me. She is 20 now, so I am 17.

wrong.why: 23 is three years older than your sister. You are younger: 20 minus 3.
20 is your sister's age. You are three years younger.
3 is the difference in age, not your age.

items.note: This asks your age. Your sister is 20 and three years older, so you are 17.
items.sentence: あねは わたしより 3さい うえです。あねは いま 20さいですから、わたしは （　）です。

items.en: The trains have stopped, so let's take a taxi.

wrong.why: If the trains were running, there would be no need for a taxi.
ついて いる is that it has arrived: no reason to take a taxi.
あいて いる is open or empty. An empty train is no reason to take a taxi.

items.note: This asks why you would take a taxi: the trains have stopped, とまって いる.
items.sentence: でんしゃが （　） いますから、タクシーで いきましょう。

items.en: Take this medicine three times a day, after meals.

wrong.why: Medicine is taken with のむ in Japanese, not たべる, even as a tablet.
あびる is for a shower.
すう is to breathe in or to smoke.

items.note: This asks the verb for taking medicine: くすりを のむ, even for tablets.
items.sentence: この くすりは 1にち 3かい、ごはんの あとに （　） ください。

items.en: I'm going to a Japanese university next year. I'm learning Japanese now.

wrong.why: You are the one going to study, so you are learning, not teaching.
わすれる is to forget, which would not help you get ready.
わかる takes が, not を, and says you understand already.

items.note: This asks what you do with Japanese before going to a Japanese university: ならう, learn it.
items.sentence: らいねん にほんの だいがくへ いきます。いま にほんごを （　） います。

items.en: I wash my hands with soap.
items.note: This asks what you wash your hands with: せっけん, soap. さとう is sugar, しお salt and さいふ a wallet.
items.sentence: （　）で てを あらいます。

items.en: I'm tired, so I'll sleep in bed.
items.note: This asks where you sleep: in a ベッド, a bed.
items.sentence: つかれましたから、（　）で ねます。

items.en: This magazine is interesting, so I buy and read it every week.
items.note: This asks what you buy and read every week: a ざっし, a magazine.
items.sentence: この （　）は おもしろいですから、まいしゅう かって よみます。

items.en: Let's eat the cake with a fork.
items.note: This asks what you eat cake with: a フォーク, a fork. A ナイフ cuts, a コップ is a cup and a ストーブ a heater.
items.sentence: ケーキは （　）で たべましょう。

items.en: My head really hurts, so I'm going to the hospital.
items.note: This asks why you go to the hospital: your head is いたい, it hurts.
items.sentence: あたまが とても （　）ですから、びょういんへ いきます。

items.en: My birthday is May 10th.
items.note: This asks what is on a date such as May 10th: your たんじょうび, your birthday.
items.sentence: わたしの （　）は 5がつ 10かです。

items.en: There's a test tomorrow, so I'll memorise the words.

wrong.why: わすれる is to forget: the opposite of what a test needs.
こまる is to be in trouble. It does not take ことばを.
おしえる is to teach. Before a test you learn the words yourself.

items.note: This asks what you do with words before a test: おぼえる, memorise them.
items.sentence: あした テストが ありますから、ことばを （　）。

items.en: I've lost my wallet and I'm in trouble.

wrong.why: Buying a wallet would not leave you in trouble.
Opening your wallet is no trouble.
Showing your wallet is no reason to be in trouble.

items.note: This asks what happened to the wallet that left you in trouble: you lost it, なくした.
items.sentence: さいふを （　）、こまって います。

items.en: I have a lot of work every day, so I'm very busy.

wrong.why: ひま is having free time: the opposite of a lot of work.
すずしい is cool, for the weather.
かわいい is cute. Work does not make you cute.

items.note: This asks what a lot of work makes you: いそがしい, busy.
items.sentence: まいにち しごとが おおくて、とても （　）です。

items.en: It's hot today, isn't it? I want a cold beer.

wrong.why: あたたかい is warm. On a hot day you want a cold drink.
ぬるい is lukewarm. On a hot day you want it cold.
ほそい is thin, for things like a pen or a road.

items.note: This asks what drink you want on a hot day: a つめたい one, cold.
items.sentence: きょうは あついですね。（　） ビールが のみたいです。

items.en: I ate all the cake, so there's none left.

wrong.why: If you ate only a little, some would be left.
ちょっと is a little. Then some would be left.
また is again. It says nothing about how much is left.

items.note: This asks how much you ate if none is left: ぜんぶ, all of it.
items.sentence: ケーキを （　） たべましたから、もう ありません。

items.en: Cross the next intersection, then turn right.

wrong.why: ろうか is a corridor, inside a building. You cross a road at an intersection.
You ride an エレベーター; you do not cross it.
へや is a room. You cross a road at an intersection.

items.note: This asks what you cross on a road before turning: a こうさてん, an intersection.
items.sentence: つぎの （　）を わたって、みぎに まがって ください。

items.en: This hat is small and very cute.

wrong.why: ふとい is thick, for a pen or a road, not a hat.
うるさい is noisy. A hat makes no noise.
すずしい is cool, for the weather.

items.note: This asks what a small hat can be: かわいい, cute.
items.sentence: この ぼうしは ちいさくて、とても （　）ですね。

items.en: I get up at six every morning. Today I got up at seven, so I got up later than usual.

wrong.why: Seven is later than six, not earlier.
たくさん is a lot, for amounts, not for times.
すこし is a little. You need a word for later: おそく.

items.note: This asks how seven compares with six in the morning: it is later, おそく.
items.sentence: わたしは まいあさ 6じに おきます。きょうは 7じに おきましたから、いつもより （　） おきました。

items.en: A: Which do you like, coffee or tea? B: I like coffee better.

wrong.why: より marks what is compared against: こうちゃより コーヒーが すき.
ほか is other. The answer picks one of the two.
まえ is in front, or before.

items.note: This asks how to answer どちら: 〜の ほうが すき, I like this one better.
items.sentence:
A「コーヒーと こうちゃと、どちらが すきですか。」
B「コーヒーの （　）が すきです。」

items.en: I bought three apples. I gave one to my sister, so now I have two.

wrong.why: You gave one away, so three is no longer right.
You had three, not four, before giving one away.
One is what you gave away. Three minus one is two.

items.note: This asks how many are left: three minus one is two, ふたつ.
items.sentence: りんごを みっつ かいました。いもうとに ひとつ あげましたから、いま （　） あります。

items.en: This soup is a bit bland. Let's add salt.

wrong.why: おおい is many. Soup that needs salt tastes weak: うすい.
あまい is sweet. Salt is added to soup that tastes weak.
ふるい is old. Salt fixes a weak taste, not age.

items.note: This asks why you add salt: the soup tastes うすい, weak or bland.
items.sentence: この スープは ちょっと （　）ですね。しおを いれましょう。

items.en: This bag isn't mine. Whose is it?

wrong.why: なに asks what. Asking whose takes だれの.
いつ asks when.
どれ asks which one. Asking whose takes だれの.

items.note: This asks which question word asks whose: だれの.
items.sentence: この かばんは わたしのでは ありません。（　）のですか。

items.en: There is a white notebook on the desk.
items.note: This asks the reading of 白い, white. くろい is 黒い (black), あかい 赤い (red) and あおい 青い (blue).
items.sentence: つくえの うえに __白い__ ノートが あります。

items.en: There is a park to the north of the station.
items.note: This asks the reading of 北, north. みなみ is 南 (south), ひがし 東 (east) and にし 西 (west).
items.sentence: えきの __北__に こうえんが あります。

items.en: I am busy with work this week.

wrong.why: 週 has a long vowel: しゅう. こんしゅ drops the う.
週 is しゅう, with no dakuten. じゅう is how 十 sounds.
今 is いま on its own, but こん in words like 今週 and 今月.

items.note: This asks the reading of 今週, this week. 今 is こん here, and 週 is a long しゅう.
items.sentence: __今週__は しごとが いそがしいです。

items.en: I came to Japan last month.

wrong.why: 月 is がつ only in the names of the months, like 四がつ. In 先月, 今月 and 来月 it is げつ.
つき is 月 on its own: the moon. In 先月 it is げつ.
先 is さき on its own (ahead), but せん in 先月 and 先週.

items.note: This asks the reading of 先月, last month. In month words like this, 月 is げつ.
items.sentence: __先月__ にほんへ きました。

items.en: I got this watch from my father.

wrong.why: On its own, 時計 is とけい. It becomes どけい only after another word, as in うでどけい (a wristwatch).
時 is じ in 時間 and 三時, but 時計 has a reading of its own: とけい.
時 is とき on its own (time), but 時計 is read とけい.

items.note: This asks the reading of 時計, a clock or watch. The word has its own reading, とけい, which its kanji do not suggest.
items.sentence: この __時計__は ちちに もらいました。

items.en: A friend is coming on the 20th of next month.

wrong.why: ふつか is 二日, the 2nd. 二十日, the 20th, is はつか.
はつか has a full つ. With a small っ, はっか is a different word (mint).
There is no にじゅっか. The 20th has its own reading, はつか, like ついたち for the 1st.

items.note: This asks the reading of 二十日, the 20th of the month. Like ついたち and ふつか, it has its own reading: はつか.
items.sentence: らいげつの __二十日__に ともだちが きます。

items.en: I walked a lot yesterday, and my feet hurt.
items.note: This asks the reading of 足, a foot or leg. て is a hand, あたま the head and おなか the stomach.
items.sentence: きのう たくさん あるいて、__足__が いたいです。

items.en: In summer I swim in the sea.
items.note: This asks the reading of 夏, summer. ふゆ is winter, はる spring and あき autumn.
items.sentence: __夏__は うみで およぎます。

items.en: I get up at six in the morning.
items.note: This asks the reading of 朝, morning. ひる is midday, よる night and ばん evening.
items.sentence: __朝__ ろくじに おきます。

items.en: We have two dogs at home.
items.note: This asks the reading of 犬, a dog. ねこ is a cat, とり a bird and うし a cow.
items.sentence: うちには __犬__が 2ひき います。

items.en: This bag is old.
items.note: This asks the reading of 古い, old (for things). わかい is young, あたらしい new and たかい high or expensive.
items.sentence: この かばんは __古い__です。

items.en: I bought meat and vegetables at the supermarket.
items.note: This asks the reading of 肉, meat. さかな is fish, たまご an egg and こめ rice.
items.sentence: スーパーで __肉__と やさいを かいました。

items.en: I am a university student.

wrong.why: 学 is がく. It becomes がっ only before some sounds, as in がっこう; before せい it stays がく.
生 is せい here, with no dakuten.
学 has a dakuten: がく.

items.note: This asks the reading of 学生, a student: がく and せい, as each kanji sounds.
items.sentence: わたしは だいがくの __学生__です。

items.en: Yesterday I saw a film on my own.

wrong.why: ふたり is two people. 一 is one: ひとり.
ひとつ counts things. One person is ひとり.
One person has a reading of its own: ひとり.

items.note: This asks the reading of 一人, one person, as in on your own: ひとり.
items.sentence: きのうは __一人__で えいがを みました。

items.en: I study Japanese every day.

wrong.why: 日 is にち here. び is its sound in the names of the days, like にちようび.
毎 is まい, not めい.
日 is にち in 毎日. じつ is its sound in only a few harder words.

items.note: This asks the reading of 毎日, every day: まい and にち.
items.sentence: __毎日__ にほんごを べんきょうします。

items.en: I am going abroad next year.

wrong.why: 外 has a dakuten in this word: がい.
国 is こく here, with no dakuten.
そと is 外 on its own, but in 外国 it is がい.

items.note: This asks the reading of 外国, a foreign country: がい and こく.
items.sentence: らいねん __外国__へ いきます。

items.en: My mother is ill in bed.

wrong.why: 病 has a long vowel: びょう.
病 has a dakuten: びょう.
気 is き here; け is its sound in only a few words.

items.note: This asks the reading of 病気, illness: a long びょう, then き.
items.sentence: ははは __病気__で ねて います。

items.en: The teacher is in the classroom now.

wrong.why: 生 has a long vowel here: せい.
先 is さき on its own, but せん in 先生.
先 has no dakuten: せん. ぜん is the sound of another kanji, as in ごぜん.

items.note: This asks the reading of 先生, a teacher: せん and a long せい.
items.sentence: __先生__は いま きょうしつに います。

items.en: I bought a little beef.

wrong.why: 牛 has a long vowel here: ぎゅう.
うし is 牛 on its own, but in 牛肉 it is ぎゅう.
牛 has a dakuten: ぎゅう.

items.note: This asks the reading of 牛肉, beef: a long ぎゅう, then にく.
items.sentence: __牛肉__を すこし かいました。

items.en: I go to school by bicycle.

wrong.why: じてんしゃ has no small っ.
車 is しゃ here, with no dakuten.
じどうしゃ is a car. A bicycle is じてんしゃ.

items.note: This asks the reading of 自転車, a bicycle: じ, てん and しゃ.
items.sentence: __自転車__で がっこうへ いきます。

items.en: I bought tomatoes at the greengrocer's in front of the station.

wrong.why: 八百屋 has a reading of its own, やおや. The sounds of the numbers do not apply.
Read as numbers it would be はっぴゃく, but 八百屋 is a word of its own: やおや.
やおや has no long お.

items.note: This asks the reading of 八百屋, a greengrocer. The word has its own reading: やおや.
items.sentence: えきの まえの __八百屋__で トマトを かいました。

items.en: What did you eat this morning?

wrong.why: いま and あさ are each kanji's sound on its own, but 今朝 is read as one word: けさ.
今朝 is read as one word, けさ, not one kanji at a time.
けさ has no small っ.

items.note: This asks the reading of 今朝, this morning. Like きょう, it is read as one word: けさ.
items.sentence: __今朝__は なにを たべましたか。

items.en: There is a test on the 8th of this month.

wrong.why: よっか, with a small っ, is the 4th. The 8th is ようか.
The long お in ようか is written with う.
八 is はち when you count, but the 8th of the month has its own reading: ようか.

items.note: This asks the reading of 八日, the 8th of the month: ようか, with a long よう.
items.sentence: こんげつの __八日__に テストが あります。

items.en: My mother is good at cooking.

wrong.why: The last sound has a dakuten: ず.
じょう is long: じょうず.
うえ and て are each kanji's sound on its own, but 上手 is read as one word: じょうず.

items.note: This asks the reading of 上手, good at something. It is read as one word: じょうず.
items.sentence: ははは りょうりが __上手__です。

items.en: It's cold, so my hands are cold.
items.note: This asks the reading of 手, a hand. かお is the face, あし a foot and くち a mouth.
items.sentence: さむいですから、__手__が つめたいです。

items.en: In winter it snows a lot.
items.note: This asks the reading of 冬, winter. なつ is summer, はる spring and あき autumn.
items.sentence: __冬__は ゆきが たくさん ふります。

items.en: There's a bird up in the tree.
items.note: This asks the reading of 鳥, a bird. ねこ is a cat, いぬ a dog and むし an insect.
items.sentence: きの うえに __鳥__が いますよ。

items.en: At midday I eat in the school cafeteria.
items.note: This asks the reading of 昼, midday. あさ is morning, よる night and ばん evening.
items.sentence: __昼__は がっこうの しょくどうで たべます。

items.en: This pencil is long, isn't it?
items.note: This asks the reading of 長い, long. みじかい is short, ふとい thick and まるい round.
items.sentence: この えんぴつは __長い__ですね。

items.en: That girl is my younger sister.
items.note: This asks the reading of 女の子, a girl. おとこのこ is a boy, おんなのひと a woman and こども a child.
items.sentence: あの __女の子__は わたしの いもうとです。

items.en: I took photos in the park.

wrong.why: 真 is しん here, with no dakuten.
しゃしん has no small っ.
写 is しゃ, with a small ゃ.

items.note: This asks the reading of 写真, a photo: しゃ and しん.
items.sentence: こうえんで __写真__を とりました。

items.en: I practise kanji every day.

wrong.why: 字 has a dakuten: じ.
漢 has no dakuten: かん.
漢 is かん, ending in ん.

items.note: This asks the reading of 漢字, kanji: かん and じ.
items.sentence: __漢字__を まいにち れんしゅうします。

items.en: It takes time to get to the station.

wrong.why: 間 is かん here, with no dakuten.
時 is とき on its own, but じ in this word.
じかん has no small っ.

items.note: This asks the reading of 時間, time: じ and かん.
items.sentence: えきまで __時間__が かかります。

items.en: My older brother is a university teacher.

wrong.why: 大 has a dakuten here: だい.
学 has a dakuten: がく.
おお is 大 in words like おおきい, but だい in this word.

items.note: This asks the reading of 大学, a university: だい and がく.
items.sentence: あには __大学__の せんせいです。

items.en: Please call me later.

wrong.why: 電 has a dakuten: でん.
The sound わ is written わ here, not は.
話 is わ in this word. でんか is a different word.

items.note: This asks the reading of 電話, a telephone: でん and わ.
items.sentence: あとで __電話__を ください。

items.en: I take a walk in the park in the early evening.

wrong.why: 方 has a dakuten here: がた.
夕 is a long ゆう.
方 is ほう in some words, but がた in this one.

items.note: This asks the reading of 夕方, the early evening: a long ゆう, then がた.
items.sentence: __夕方__ こうえんを さんぽします。

items.en: I clean my own room.

wrong.why: 分 is ぶん here, with a dakuten.
分 has a dakuten, ぶ, not the small circle.
自 has a dakuten: じ.

items.note: This asks the reading of 自分, yourself: じ and ぶん.
items.sentence: __自分__の へやを そうじします。

items.en: This summer is very hot.

wrong.why: いま and とし are each kanji's sound on its own, but this word is read as one: ことし.
きょねん is last year. This year is ことし.
ことし has no dakuten.

items.note: This asks the reading of 今年, this year. It is read as one word: ことし.
items.sentence: __今年__の なつは とても あついです。

items.en: There's no school tomorrow.

wrong.why: あさって is the day after tomorrow. This word is tomorrow: あした.
This word is read as one, not one kanji at a time: あした.
あした has no dakuten.

items.note: This asks the reading of 明日, tomorrow. It is read as one word: あした.
items.sentence: __明日__は がっこうが やすみです。

items.en: The 7th of next month is a Sunday.

wrong.why: 七 is なな when you count, but the 7th of the month is なのか.
しち is a counting sound too, but the 7th of the month is なのか.
The 7th has its own reading, なのか, ending in か.

items.note: This asks the reading of 七日, the 7th of the month: なのか.
items.sentence: らいげつの __七日__は にちようびです。

items.en: I am bad at singing.

wrong.why: へた has no dakuten.
げ and て are sounds of these kanji in other words, but this word is read as one: へた.
じょうず is the opposite: good at something.

items.note: This asks the reading of 下手, bad at something. It is read as one word: へた.
items.sentence: わたしは うたが __下手__です。

items.en: What are you doing today?

wrong.why: いま and ひ are each kanji's sound on its own, but this word is read as one: きょう.
The long お in きょう is written with う.
This word is read as one, not one kanji at a time: きょう.

items.note: This asks the reading of 今日, today. It is read as one word: きょう.
items.sentence: __今日__は なにを しますか。

items.en: In spring the cherry blossoms are beautiful.
items.note: This asks the reading of 春, spring. なつ is summer, ふゆ winter and あき autumn.
items.sentence: __春__は さくらが きれいです。

items.en: Let's eat vegetables every day.
items.note: This asks the reading of 野菜, vegetables. くだもの is fruit, おかし sweets and さかな fish.
items.sentence: まいにち __野菜__を たべましょう。

items.en: I have a cold, and my head hurts.
items.note: This asks the reading of 頭, the head. おなか is the stomach, のど the throat and せなか the back.
items.sentence: かぜで __頭__が いたいです。

items.en: Children are playing in the park.
items.note: This asks the reading of 子ども, a child. あかちゃん is a baby, おとこ a man and おじいさん a grandfather.
items.sentence: こうえんで __子ども__が あそんで います。

items.en: This town is very quiet.
items.note: This asks the reading of 町, a town. むら is a village, くに a country and いえ a house.
items.sentence: この __町__は とても しずかです。

items.en: What is your favourite colour?
items.note: This asks the reading of 色, a colour. あじ is a taste, かたち a shape and おと a sound.
items.sentence: すきな __色__は なんですか。

items.en: There is a bank in front of the station.

wrong.why: 銀 has a dakuten: ぎん.
行 is こう in this word. ぎょう is its sound in other words.
い(く) is 行 in the verb いく, but in this word it is こう.

items.note: This asks the reading of 銀行, a bank: ぎん and こう.
items.sentence: えきの まえに __銀行__が あります。

items.en: I eat lunch in the cafeteria.

wrong.why: 堂 has a dakuten: どう.
堂 is a long どう.
たべ is 食 in the verb たべる, but in this word it is しょく.

items.note: This asks the reading of 食堂, a cafeteria: しょく and a long どう.
items.sentence: __食堂__で ひるごはんを たべます。

items.en: This temple is very famous.

wrong.why: 有 is a long ゆう.
名 is めい in this word. な is its sound in なまえ.
名 is めい here. みょう is its sound in only a few words.

items.note: This asks the reading of 有名, famous: ゆう and めい.
items.sentence: この おてらは とても __有名__です。

items.en: My father's cooking is good.

wrong.why: 料 is a long りょう.
料 is りょう, with a small ょ.
理 is り.

items.note: This asks the reading of 料理, cooking: a long りょう, then り.
items.sentence: ちちの __料理__は おいしいです。

items.en: I'm going on a trip with my family in the summer holidays.

wrong.why: 旅 is a short りょ.
行 is こう in this word, with no dakuten.
たび is 旅 on its own, but りょ in this word.

items.note: This asks the reading of 旅行, a trip: a short りょ, then こう.
items.sentence: なつやすみに かぞくで __旅行__します。

items.en: I listen to music in my room at night.

wrong.why: 楽 is がく in this word. らく is its sound in other words.
楽 has a dakuten: がく.
おと is 音 on its own, but おん in this word.

items.note: This asks the reading of 音楽, music: おん and がく.
items.sentence: よる へやで __音楽__を ききます。

items.en: I like animals.

wrong.why: 物 is ぶつ in this word. もの is its sound on its own.
動 has a dakuten: どう.
動 is a long どう.

items.note: This asks the reading of 動物, an animal: どう and ぶつ.
items.sentence: わたしは __動物__が すきです。

items.en: The 9th of this month is a Saturday.

wrong.why: 九 is きゅう when you count, but the 9th of the month is ここのか.
ここのつ is nine things. The 9th of the month is ここのか.
ここのか has no small っ.

items.note: This asks the reading of 九日, the 9th of the month. It has its own reading: ここのか.
items.sentence: こんげつの __九日__は どようびです。

items.en: The film is 1,000 yen for adults and 500 yen for children.

wrong.why: おとな has no long う.
おとな has no dakuten.
おお and ひと are each kanji's sound on its own, but this word is read as one: おとな.

items.note: This asks the reading of 大人, an adult. It is read as one word: おとな.
items.sentence: えいがは __大人__ 1000えん、こども 500えんです。

items.en: The two of us went to a restaurant.

wrong.why: ふたつ counts things. Two people is ふたり.
ふたり has no dakuten.
Two people has a reading of its own: ふたり.

items.note: This asks the reading of 二人, two people. Like ひとり for one, it has its own reading: ふたり.
items.sentence: __二人__で レストランへ いきました。

items.en: It's cold, so please put on a jacket.

wrong.why: 上 is うえ on its own, but うわ in this word.
じょう is 上 in some words, but this one is うわぎ.
うわぎ has no small っ.

items.note: This asks the reading of 上着, a jacket: うわ, then ぎ.
items.sentence: さむいですから、__上着__を きて ください。

items.en: The day after tomorrow is Sunday.

wrong.why: This word is read as one, not one kanji at a time: あさって.
あさって has a small っ.
あさって has no dakuten.

items.note: This asks the reading of 明後日, the day after tomorrow. It is read as one word: あさって.
items.sentence: __明後日__は にちようびです。

items.en: I went to the sea in the summer holidays.
items.note: This asks the reading of 海, the sea. やま is a mountain, かわ a river and いけ a pond.
items.sentence: なつやすみに __海__へ いきました。

items.en: Yesterday's party was a fun party.
items.note: This asks the reading of 楽しい, fun. いそがしい is busy, つまらない dull and むずかしい difficult.
items.sentence: きのうの パーティーは __楽しい__ パーティーでした。

items.en: Please write your name on this paper.
items.note: This asks the reading of 紙, paper. かさ is an umbrella, え a picture and じ a letter.
items.sentence: この __紙__に なまえを かいて ください。

items.en: I bought a brown bag.
items.note: This asks the reading of 茶色, brown. きいろ is yellow, くろ black and みどり green.
items.sentence: __茶色__の かばんを かいました。

items.en: There are four people in my family.
items.note: This asks the reading of 家族, a family. きょうだい is brothers and sisters, ともだち friends and がっこう a school.
items.sentence: わたしの __家族__は 4にんです。

items.en: I always rest at home on Sundays.
items.note: This asks the reading of 日曜日, Sunday. どようび is Saturday, げつようび Monday and きんようび Friday.
items.sentence: __日曜日__は いつも うちで やすみます。

items.en: My older brother teaches English.

wrong.why: 語 has a dakuten: ご.
英 is a long えい.
英 is えい in this word.

items.note: This asks the reading of 英語, English: a long えい, then ご.
items.sentence: あには __英語__を おしえて います。

items.en: Let's meet at the station at 10 in the morning.

wrong.why: 前 has a dakuten in this word: ぜん.
まえ is 前 on its own, but ぜん in this word.
午 has a dakuten: ご.

items.note: This asks the reading of 午前, the morning (a.m.): ご and ぜん.
items.sentence: __午前__ 10じに えきで あいましょう。

items.en: This question is difficult.

wrong.why: 題 has a dakuten: だい.
問 is もん, ending in ん.
問 is もん in this word.

items.note: This asks the reading of 問題, a question or problem: もん and だい.
items.sentence: この __問題__は むずかしいです。

items.en: I play tennis every Saturday.

wrong.why: 週 is a long しゅう.
週 has no dakuten: しゅう.
毎 is まい.

items.note: This asks the reading of 毎週, every week: まい and a long しゅう.
items.sentence: __毎週__ どようびに テニスを します。

items.en: This photo is very precious.

wrong.why: 大 is たい in this word, with no dakuten.
切 is せつ in this word. き(る) is its sound in the verb.
おお is 大 in some words, but たい in this one.

items.note: This asks the reading of 大切, important or precious: たい and せつ.
items.sentence: この しゃしんは とても __大切__です。

items.en: What is that tall building?

wrong.why: 建 is たて in this word.
物 is もの here. ぶつ is its sound in other words.
建 has no dakuten: たて.

items.note: This asks the reading of 建物, a building: たて and もの.
items.sentence: あの たかい __建物__は なんですか。

items.en: Where is the embassy?

wrong.why: 大 is たい in this word, with no dakuten.
館 is かん, with no dakuten.
使 is し in this word. つか(う) is its sound in the verb.

items.note: This asks the reading of 大使館, an embassy: たい, し and かん.
items.sentence: __大使館__は どこに ありますか。

items.en: The 1st of next month is a Monday.

wrong.why: ついたち has no dakuten.
つい is short: ついたち.
The 1st of the month has its own reading: ついたち.

items.note: This asks the reading of 一日 as a date, the 1st of the month: ついたち.
items.sentence: らいげつの __一日__は げつようびです。

items.en: May 5th is Children's Day.

wrong.why: 五 is ご when you count, but the 5th of the month is いつか.
いつか has no small っ.
いつつ is five things. The 5th of the month is いつか.

items.note: This asks the reading of 五日, the 5th of the month. It has its own reading: いつか.
items.sentence: 5がつ __五日__は こどもの ひです。

items.en: I love cake.

wrong.why: 大 is だい in this word.
大 has a dakuten in this word: だい.
すき keeps its own sound here, with no dakuten.

items.note: This asks the reading of 大好き, to love: だい and すき.
items.sentence: わたしは ケーキが __大好き__です。

items.en: I bought this book three days ago.

wrong.why: 三 is さん when you count, but three days is みっか.
みっか has a small っ.
みっつ is three things. Three days is みっか.

items.note: This asks the reading of 三日, three days or the 3rd: みっか.
items.sentence: __三日__ まえに この ほんを かいました。

items.en: Eight apples, please.

wrong.why: Things are counted ひとつ, ふたつ … やっつ: eight is やっつ.
やっつ has no dakuten.
よっつ is four. Eight is やっつ.

items.note: This asks the reading of 八つ, eight things: やっつ.
items.sentence: りんごを __八つ__ ください。

items.en: I saw a film yesterday.
items.note: This asks the reading of 見ました, saw or watched. ききました is heard, よみました read and かきました wrote.
items.sentence: きのう えいがを __見ました__。

items.en: Everyone, please stand up.
items.note: This asks the reading of 立って, stand up. すわって is sit down, はしって run and ねて lie down or sleep.
items.sentence: みんな __立って__ ください。

items.en: Did you eat breakfast?
items.note: This asks the reading of 食べました, ate. のみました is drank, つくりました made and あらいました washed.
items.sentence: あさごはんを __食べました__か。

items.en: This town has a lot of people.
items.note: This asks the reading of 多い, many. すくない is few, ちかい near and ひろい wide.
items.sentence: この まちは ひとが __多い__です。

items.en: A friend is coming to my house tomorrow.

wrong.why: The verb is くる, but before ます it is き: きます.
いきます is 行きます, to go. 来ます is to come.
こ is 来 in こない. Before ます it is き.

items.note: This asks the reading of 来ます, to come. くる changes its sound: きます, きて, こない.
items.sentence: あした ともだちが うちに __来ます__。

items.en: I listen to the radio every morning.

wrong.why: The second き has no dakuten: ききます.
ぶん is 聞 in しんぶん, but the verb is きく.
The ます form of きく is ききます.

items.note: This asks the reading of 聞きます, to listen: き, then きます.
items.sentence: まいあさ ラジオを __聞きます__。

items.en: I'll go home at six.

wrong.why: The verb is かえる: かえります.
き is 帰 in some words, but the verb is かえる.
かえます is a different verb, to change. To go home is かえります.

items.note: This asks the reading of 帰ります, to go home: かえ, then ります.
items.sentence: 6じに うちへ __帰ります__。

items.en: Please use this pen.

wrong.why: し is 使 in たいしかん, but the verb is つかう.
つかって has no dakuten.
The て form of つかう is つかって.

items.note: This asks the reading of 使って, use: つか, then って.
items.sentence: この ペンを __使って__ ください。

items.en: Please carry this luggage.

wrong.why: じ is 持 in some words, but the verb is もつ.
The て form of もつ is もって.
もって has no long う.

items.note: This asks the reading of 持って, hold or carry: も, then って.
items.sentence: この にもつを __持って__ ください。

items.en: My older brother is strong at tennis.

wrong.why: よわい is weak, the opposite.
The middle sound is よ, not お: つ・よ・い.
きょう is 強 in べんきょう, but the adjective is つよい.

items.note: This asks the reading of 強い, strong: つよい.
items.sentence: あには テニスが __強い__です。

items.en: I came to Japan two days ago.

wrong.why: Two days is ふつか, with つ.
ふつか has a full つ, not a small っ.
Two days has its own reading: ふつか.

items.note: This asks the reading of 二日, two days or the 2nd: ふつか.
items.sentence: __二日__ まえに にほんへ きました。

items.en: June 4th is a Tuesday.

wrong.why: 四 is よん when you count, but the 4th is よっか.
よっか has a small っ.
The 4th of the month has its own reading: よっか.

items.note: This asks the reading of 四日, the 4th of the month: よっか.
items.sentence: 6がつ __四日__は かようびです。

items.en: Where is your mother?

wrong.why: はは is 母 on its own, but this word is read おかあさん.
おかあさん has a long あ.
おばあさん is a grandmother. Mother is おかあさん.

items.note: This asks the reading of お母さん, mother: おかあさん. On its own, 母 is はは.
items.sentence: __お母さん__は どこですか。

items.en: I live in a big house.

wrong.why: 大 is おお in this word.
おおきな has no dakuten.
おおきな has a long お: おお.

items.note: This asks the reading of 大きな, big, which comes before a noun: おおきな.
items.sentence: __大きな__ いえに すんで います。

items.en: This room is small.
items.answer: この へやは ひろくないです。
wrong: この へやは ひろいです。
この へやは あかるくないです。
この へやは しずかです。
items.note: This asks for another way to say せまい, small (of a space): ひろくない, not spacious.
items.sentence: この へやは せまいです。

items.en: I drink coffee every morning.
items.answer: わたしは あさは いつも コーヒーを のみます。
wrong: わたしは あさは ときどき コーヒーを のみます。
わたしは よるは いつも コーヒーを のみます。
わたしは あさは あまり コーヒーを のみません。
items.note: This asks for another way to say まいあさ, every morning: あさは いつも.
items.sentence: わたしは まいあさ コーヒーを のみます。

items.en: This film was boring.
items.answer: この えいがは おもしろくなかったです。

wrong.option: この えいがは おもしろかったです。
wrong.why: おもしろかった is the opposite: the film was fun.

wrong.option: この えいがは みじかかったです。
wrong.why: みじかい is short. つまらない is about being dull, not about length.

wrong.option: この えいがは ながかったです。
wrong.why: ながい is long. A long film is not always a dull one.

items.note: This asks for another way to say つまらない, boring: おもしろくない, not interesting.
items.sentence: この えいがは つまらなかったです。

items.en: This is the kitchen.
items.answer: ここで りょうりを します。

wrong.why: You sleep in a bedroom. A だいどころ is for cooking.

wrong.option: ここで おふろに はいります。
wrong.why: That is the bathroom. A だいどころ is for cooking.

wrong.option: ここで べんきょうを します。
wrong.why: A だいどころ is a kitchen, for cooking, not for studying.

items.note: This asks what a だいどころ is: the room where you cook, りょうりを する ところ.
items.sentence: ここは だいどころです。

items.en: I went to the hospital the day before yesterday.
items.answer: わたしは ふつかまえに びょういんへ いきました。

wrong.option: わたしは きのう びょういんへ いきました。
wrong.why: きのう is one day ago. おととい is two.

wrong.option: わたしは みっかまえに びょういんへ いきました。
wrong.why: みっかまえ is three days ago. おととい is two.

wrong.option: わたしは けさ びょういんへ いきました。
wrong.why: けさ is this morning. おととい is two days ago.

items.note: This asks for another way to say おととい, the day before yesterday: ふつかまえ, two days ago.
items.sentence: わたしは おととい びょういんへ いきました。

items.en: I am going to Tokyo the day after tomorrow.
items.answer: わたしは あしたの つぎの ひに とうきょうへ いきます。

wrong.option: わたしは きのうの つぎの ひに とうきょうへ いきます。
wrong.why: The day after yesterday is today, not あさって.

wrong.option: わたしは あしたの まえの ひに とうきょうへ いきます。
wrong.why: The day before tomorrow is today, not あさって.

wrong.option: わたしは おとといの つぎの ひに とうきょうへ いきます。
wrong.why: The day after おととい is きのう, yesterday.

items.note: This asks which day あさって is: the day after tomorrow, あしたの つぎの ひ. Each wrong option counts from another day and lands somewhere else.
items.sentence: わたしは あさって とうきょうへ いきます。

items.en: My older brother is taller than me.
items.answer: わたしは あにより せが ひくいです。

wrong.option: わたしは あにより せが たかいです。
wrong.why: This turns it round: here I am the taller one.

wrong.option: あには わたしより せが ひくいです。
wrong.why: This says my brother is shorter, the opposite.

wrong.option: わたしと あには せが おなじぐらいです。
wrong.why: おなじぐらい is about the same height, but the sentence says he is taller.

items.note: This asks for the same comparison from the other side: if my brother is taller than me, I am shorter than him, あにより ひくい.
items.sentence: あには わたしより せが たかいです。

items.en: I love sushi.
items.answer: わたしは すしが とても すきです。
wrong: わたしは すしが あまり すきじゃ ありません。
わたしは すしが すこし すきです。
わたしは すしが きらいです。
items.note: This asks for another way to say だいすき, to love: とても すき.
items.sentence: わたしは すしが だいすきです。

items.en: The weather is nice today.
items.answer: きょうは はれて います。
wrong: きょうは あめが ふって います。
きょうは くもって います。
きょうは さむいです。
items.note: This asks what いい てんき means: fine weather, a sunny day, はれ.
items.sentence: きょうは いい てんきです。

items.en: My father is out right now.
items.answer: ちちは いま うちに いません。
wrong: ちちは いま うちに います。
ちちは いま ねて います。
ちちは いま しごとを して います。
items.note: This asks what でかけて いる means: someone has gone out, so they are not at home, うちに いない.
items.sentence: ちちは いま でかけて います。

items.en: I am twenty this year.
items.answer: わたしは ことし にじゅっさいです。

wrong.option: わたしは ことし じゅっさいです。
wrong.why: じゅっさい is ten years old. はたち is twenty.

wrong.option: わたしは ことし にさいです。
wrong.why: にさい is two years old. はたち is twenty.

wrong.option: わたしは ことし にじゅうにさいです。
wrong.why: にじゅうにさい is twenty-two. はたち is twenty.

items.note: This asks what はたち means: twenty years old, にじゅっさい. The age twenty has a word of its own.
items.sentence: わたしは ことし はたちです。

items.en: This park is lively.
items.answer: この こうえんには ひとが おおぜい います。

wrong.option: この こうえんは しずかです。
wrong.why: しずか is quiet, the opposite of にぎやか.

wrong.option: この こうえんには ひとが あまり いません。
wrong.why: Few people make a park quiet, not にぎやか.

wrong.option: この こうえんは きれいです。
wrong.why: きれい is pretty or clean. にぎやか is about people and noise.

items.note: This asks what にぎやか means: lively, with many people about, ひとが おおぜい.
items.sentence: この こうえんは にぎやかです。

items.en: I didn't have breakfast.
items.answer: わたしは けさ なにも たべませんでした。

wrong.option: わたしは けさ たくさん たべました。
wrong.why: This is the opposite: it says you ate a lot.

wrong.option: わたしは ゆうべ なにも たべませんでした。
wrong.why: ゆうべ is last night. The sentence is about the morning.

wrong.option: わたしは ひるごはんを たべませんでした。
wrong.why: ひるごはん is lunch. あさごはん is breakfast.

items.note: This asks for another way to say you had no breakfast: けさ なにも たべませんでした, you ate nothing this morning.
items.sentence: わたしは あさごはんを たべませんでした。

items.en: This shop closes at nine at night.
items.answer: この みせは よる 9じまで あいて います。

wrong.option: この みせは よる 9じから あいて います。
wrong.why: から is from: this shop would open at nine at night.

wrong.option: この みせは あさ 9じに しまります。
wrong.why: あさ is the morning. The shop closes at night.

wrong.option: この みせは よる 9じに あきます。
wrong.why: あく is to open. しまる is to close.

items.note: This asks for another way to say the shop closes at nine at night: it is open until then, 9じまで あいて います.
items.sentence: この みせは よる 9じに しまります。

items.en: My mother's younger brother is a doctor.
items.answer: わたしの おじさんは いしゃです。

wrong.option: わたしの おじいさんは いしゃです。
wrong.why: おじいさん, with a long い, is a grandfather. Your mother's brother is おじさん.

wrong.option: わたしの おばさんは いしゃです。
wrong.why: おばさん is an aunt, a woman. ははの おとうと is a man.

wrong.option: わたしの おとうとは いしゃです。
wrong.why: おとうと is your own younger brother. Your mother's younger brother is your uncle.

items.note: This asks who your mother's younger brother is: your uncle, おじさん.
items.sentence: ははの おとうとは いしゃです。

items.en: I stayed home from school yesterday.
items.answer: わたしは きのう がっこうへ いきませんでした。

wrong.option: わたしは きのう がっこうへ いきました。
wrong.why: This is the opposite: it says you went to school.

wrong.option: わたしは きのう がっこうで やすみました。
wrong.why: がっこうで やすみました is resting at school, so you were there. がっこうを やすむ is staying away.

wrong.option: わたしは きのう がっこうに おそく つきました。
wrong.why: This says you were late, but you still went.

items.note: This asks what がっこうを やすむ means: to stay away from school, がっこうへ いかない.
items.sentence: わたしは きのう がっこうを やすみました。

items.en: This shop is closed on Sundays.
items.answer: この みせは にちようびに あいて いません。
wrong: この みせは にちようびに あいて います。
この みせは どようびが やすみです。
この みせは にちようびが いそがしいです。
items.note: This asks what やすみ means for a shop: it is closed, あいて いない.
items.sentence: この みせは にちようびが やすみです。

items.en: I walk to school every day.
items.answer: わたしは まいにち がっこうまで あるきます。
wrong: わたしは まいにち バスで がっこうへ いきます。
わたしは まいにち はしって がっこうへ いきます。
わたしは まいにち がっこうから あるいて かえります。
items.note: This asks for another way to say you go to school on foot: がっこうまで あるく.
items.sentence: わたしは まいにち あるいて がっこうへ いきます。

items.en: I left home at seven this morning.
items.answer: わたしは けさ 7じに でかけました。
wrong: わたしは けさ 7じに かえりました。
わたしは けさ 7じに おきました。
わたしは けさ 7じに うちに いました。
items.note: This asks for another way to say you left home: でかけました, went out.
items.sentence: わたしは けさ 7じに うちを でました。

items.en: My older sister is bad at cooking.
items.answer: あねは りょうりが じょうずじゃ ありません。

wrong.option: あねは りょうりが じょうずです。
wrong.why: じょうず is good at it, the opposite of へた.

wrong.option: あねは りょうりが きらいです。
wrong.why: きらい is to dislike. へた is about skill, not liking.

wrong.option: あねは りょうりを しません。
wrong.why: This says she never cooks. へた says she cooks badly.

items.note: This asks what へた means: bad at something, じょうずじゃ ない.
items.sentence: あねは りょうりが へたです。

items.en: Few people live in this town.
items.answer: この まちには ひとが あまり いません。

wrong.option: この まちには ひとが おおぜい います。
wrong.why: おおぜい is many people, the opposite of すくない.

wrong.option: この まちには ひとが ぜんぜん いません。
wrong.why: ぜんぜん いません is nobody at all. すくない is a few.

wrong.option: この まちは ひとが おおいです。
wrong.why: おおい is many, the opposite of すくない.

items.note: This asks what すくない means here: there are not many people, ひとが あまり いない.
items.sentence: この まちは ひとが すくないです。

items.en: Yamada lent me a dictionary.
items.answer: わたしは やまださんに じしょを かりました。

wrong.option: わたしは やまださんに じしょを かしました。
wrong.why: This turns it round: here you lent the dictionary to やまださん.

wrong.option: やまださんは わたしに じしょを かりました。
wrong.why: This says やまださん borrowed it from you, the other way round.

wrong.option: わたしは やまださんに じしょを あげました。
wrong.why: あげる is to give something away for good, and here it goes the other way.

items.note: This asks for the same lending from the other side: if やまださん lent it to you, you borrowed it, かりました.
items.sentence: やまださんは わたしに じしょを かしました。

items.en: I have no work tomorrow.
items.answer: あしたは やすみです。

wrong.option: あしたは しごとが たくさん あります。
wrong.why: This is the opposite: a busy day at work.

wrong.option: あしたは しごとが はやく おわります。
wrong.why: This says you work, but finish early.

wrong.option: あしたは しごとに おそく いきます。
wrong.why: This says you go to work, only late.

items.note: This asks for another way to say you have no work: やすみ, a day off.
items.sentence: あしたは しごとが ありません。

items.en: I got a book from my older brother.
items.answer: あには わたしに ほんを くれました。

wrong.option: わたしは あにに ほんを あげました。
wrong.why: This turns it round: here you gave the book to your brother.

wrong.option: あには わたしに ほんを もらいました。
wrong.why: This says your brother got the book from you, the other way round.

wrong.option: あには わたしに ほんを かしました。
wrong.why: かす is to lend: you would give the book back. もらう is to keep it.

items.note: This asks for the same gift from the giver's side: you got it from your brother, so he gave it to you, くれました.
items.sentence: わたしは あにに ほんを もらいました。

items.en: Yamada is older than me.
items.answer: わたしは やまださんより わかいです。

wrong.option: やまださんは わたしより わかいです。
wrong.why: This turns it round: やまださん would be the younger one.

wrong.option: わたしは やまださんより としが うえです。
wrong.why: This says you are the older one.

wrong.option: わたしと やまださんは おなじ としです。
wrong.why: おなじ とし is the same age, but やまださん is older.

items.note: This asks for the same comparison from the other side: if やまださん is older than you, you are younger, わかい.
items.sentence: やまださんは わたしより としが うえです。

items.en: I go to bed at ten every night and get up at six every morning.
items.answer: わたしは まいにち 8じかん ねます。

wrong.option: わたしは まいにち 6じかん ねます。
wrong.why: From ten at night to six in the morning is eight hours, not six.

wrong.option: わたしは まいにち 4じかん ねます。
wrong.why: Ten minus six is four, but sleep runs on past midnight: from ten to six is eight hours.

wrong.option: わたしは まいにち 10じかん ねます。
wrong.why: Ten is the time you go to bed, not how long you sleep.

items.note: This asks how long you sleep: from ten at night to six in the morning, 8じかん.
items.sentence: わたしは まいばん 10じに ねて、まいあさ 6じに おきます。

items.en: This room is cold.
items.answer: この へやは あたたかくないです。
wrong: この へやは あたたかいです。
この へやは あかるくないです。
この へやは しずかじゃ ありません。
items.note: This asks for another way to say さむい, cold: あたたかくない, not warm.
items.sentence: この へやは さむいです。

items.en: This cake is not very good.
items.answer: この ケーキは まずいです。
wrong: この ケーキは おいしいです。
この ケーキは たかいです。
この ケーキは あまいです。
items.note: This asks for another way to say a food is not good: まずい.
items.sentence: この ケーキは あまり おいしくないです。

items.en: My house is next to the school.
items.answer: わたしの いえは がっこうの すぐ よこです。
wrong: わたしの いえは がっこうの まえです。
わたしの いえは がっこうから とおいです。
わたしの いえは がっこうの うしろです。
items.note: This asks for another way to say となり, next door: すぐ よこ, right beside.
items.sentence: わたしの いえは がっこうの となりです。

items.en: I am learning Japanese.
items.answer: わたしは にほんごを べんきょうして います。

wrong.option: わたしは にほんごを おしえて います。
wrong.why: おしえる is to teach, the other way round.

wrong.option: わたしは にほんごを はなして います。
wrong.why: はなす is to speak. ならう is to learn.

wrong.option: わたしは にほんごが わかりません。
wrong.why: This says you do not understand Japanese. ならう says you are learning it.

items.note: This asks for another way to say ならう, to learn: べんきょうする, to study.
items.sentence: わたしは にほんごを ならって います。

items.en: It will probably rain tomorrow.
items.answer: あしたは たぶん あめです。

wrong.option: あしたは あめが ふりません。
wrong.why: This is the opposite: no rain.

wrong.option: きのうは あめが ふりました。
wrong.why: This is about yesterday, and what did happen. でしょう is about what will probably happen.

wrong.option: あしたは ゆきが ふるでしょう。
wrong.why: ゆき is snow, not rain.

items.note: This asks for another way to say でしょう, probably: たぶん.
items.sentence: あしたは あめが ふるでしょう。

items.en: My father is a bank clerk.
items.answer: わたしの ちちは ぎんこうで はたらいて います。

wrong.option: わたしの ちちは ぎんこうで かいものを します。
wrong.why: You shop at a shop, not at a bank. A ぎんこういん works at one.

wrong.option: わたしの ちちは びょういんで はたらいて います。
wrong.why: びょういん is a hospital. A ぎんこういん works at a bank.

wrong.option: わたしの ちちは ぎんこうへ よく いきます。
wrong.why: This says he often goes to the bank, not that he works there.

items.note: This asks what a ぎんこういん is: someone who works at a bank, ぎんこうで はたらく ひと.
items.sentence: わたしの ちちは ぎんこういんです。

items.en: This shop is open from Tuesday to Sunday.
items.answer: この みせは げつようびが やすみです。

wrong.option: この みせは かようびが やすみです。
wrong.why: かようび is the first day it is open. Only げつようび is left out.

wrong.option: この みせは にちようびが やすみです。
wrong.why: にちようび is the last day it is open.

wrong.option: この みせは まいにち あいて います。
wrong.why: げつようび is not among the days, so it is not open every day.

items.note: This asks which day is left out. Tuesday to Sunday is six days; the shop is closed on Monday, げつようび.
items.sentence: この みせは かようびから にちようびまで あいて います。

items.en: This pen is 100 yen, and that pen is 150 yen.
items.answer: あの ペンは この ペンより 50えん たかいです。

wrong.option: この ペンは あの ペンより 50えん たかいです。
wrong.why: This turns it round: この ペン is the cheaper one.

wrong.option: あの ペンは この ペンより 50えん やすいです。
wrong.why: あの ペン costs more, not less.

wrong.option: あの ペンは この ペンより 150えん たかいです。
wrong.why: 150 yen is its price. The difference is 50 yen.

items.note: This asks for the same prices as a comparison: 150 yen is 50 yen more than 100, so あの ペン is 50えん たかい.
items.sentence: この ペンは 100えんで、あの ペンは 150えんです。

items.en: The class began at nine and ended at twelve.
items.answer: じゅぎょうは 3じかん でした。

wrong.option: じゅぎょうは 12じかん でした。
wrong.why: 12 is the time it ended, not how long it was.

wrong.option: じゅぎょうは 9じかん でした。
wrong.why: 9 is the time it began. From nine to twelve is three hours.

wrong.option: じゅぎょうは 4じかん でした。
wrong.why: From nine to twelve is three hours, not four.

items.note: This asks how long the class was: from nine to twelve, 3じかん.
items.sentence: じゅぎょうは 9じに はじまって、12じに おわりました。

items.en: I like fish more than meat.
items.answer: わたしは さかなの ほうが すきです。
wrong: わたしは にくの ほうが すきです。
わたしは にくも さかなも すきです。
わたしは にくも さかなも きらいです。
items.note: This asks for another way to say you like fish more than meat: さかなの ほうが すき.
items.sentence: わたしは にくより さかなが すきです。

items.en: This is a café.
items.answer: ここで コーヒーを のみます。
wrong: ここで ほんを かります。
ここで くすりを かいます。
items.note: This asks what a きっさてん is: a place to drink coffee, コーヒーを のむ ところ.
items.sentence: ここは きっさてんです。

items.en: I always get up at seven.
items.answer: わたしは まいあさ 7じに おきます。
wrong: わたしは ときどき 7じに おきます。
わたしは まいばん 7じに おきます。
わたしは きのう 7じに おきました。
items.note: This asks for another way to say you always get up at seven: まいあさ, every morning.
items.sentence: わたしは いつも 7じに おきます。

items.en: I caught a cold yesterday.
items.answer: わたしは きのう びょうきに なりました。

wrong.option: わたしは きのう げんきに なりました。
wrong.why: げんきに なる is getting well, the opposite.

wrong.option: きのうは かぜが つよかったです。
wrong.why: This かぜ is the wind. かぜを ひく, with ひく, is catching a cold.

wrong.option: わたしは きのう くすりを かいました。
wrong.why: This says you bought medicine, not that you fell ill.

items.note: This asks what かぜを ひく means: to catch a cold, to fall ill, びょうきに なる.
items.sentence: わたしは きのう かぜを ひきました。

items.en: My mother is cooking in the kitchen now.
items.answer: ははは いま だいどころで ごはんを つくって います。

wrong.option: ははは いま だいどころで ごはんを たべて います。
wrong.why: たべる is eating. りょうりを する is cooking: making the food.

wrong.option: ははは いま だいどころで おさらを あらって います。
wrong.why: This is washing the dishes, not cooking.

wrong.option: ははは いま だいどころで ごはんを かって います。
wrong.why: かう is to buy. Nobody buys food in their kitchen.

items.note: This asks what りょうりを する means: to cook, ごはんを つくる.
items.sentence: ははは いま だいどころで りょうりを して います。

items.en: I take a walk every day.
items.answer: わたしは まいにち すこし あるきます。

wrong.option: わたしは まいにち すこし はしります。
wrong.why: はしる is to run. さんぽ is a walk.

wrong.option: わたしは まいにち すこし およぎます。
wrong.why: およぐ is to swim. さんぽ is a walk.

wrong.option: わたしは ときどき すこし あるきます。
wrong.why: ときどき is sometimes. まいにち is every day.

items.note: This asks what さんぽを する means: to go for a walk, すこし あるく.
items.sentence: わたしは まいにち さんぽを します。

items.en: I will be 20 next year.
items.answer: わたしは ことし 19さいです。

wrong.option: わたしは ことし 20さいです。
wrong.why: If you turn 20 next year, you are 19 this year.

wrong.option: わたしは ことし 21さいです。
wrong.why: 21 is older than you will be next year.

wrong.option: わたしは きょねん 20さいでした。
wrong.why: Last year you were 18. 20 comes next year.

items.note: This asks your age now. If you turn 20 next year, this year you are 19.
items.sentence: わたしは らいねん 20さいに なります。

items.en: It's 1:15 now. The class starts in 30 minutes.
items.answer: じゅぎょうは 1じ 45ふんに はじまります。

wrong.option: じゅぎょうは 1じ 30ぷんに はじまります。
wrong.why: 1:30 is only 15 minutes from now.

wrong.option: じゅぎょうは 12じ 45ふんに はじまりました。
wrong.why: That is 30 minutes ago. The class starts 30 minutes from now.

wrong.option: じゅぎょうは 2じ 15ふんに はじまります。
wrong.why: 2:15 is an hour from now, not 30 minutes.

items.note: This asks when the class starts: 30 minutes after 1:15 is 1:45.
items.sentence: いま 1じ 15ふんです。じゅぎょうは 30ぷん あとに はじまります。

items.en: I lent Tanaka a pen.
items.answer: たなかさんは わたしに ペンを かりました。

wrong.option: たなかさんは わたしに ペンを かしました。
wrong.why: This turns it round: here たなかさん lent the pen.

wrong.option: わたしは たなかさんに ペンを かりました。
wrong.why: This says you borrowed it, the other way round.

wrong.option: わたしは たなかさんに ペンを もらいました。
wrong.why: もらう is to receive and keep, and here it goes the other way.

items.note: This asks for the same lending from the other side: if you lent it, たなかさん borrowed it from you, かりました.
items.sentence: わたしは たなかさんに ペンを かしました。

items.en: It is very cold today.
items.answer: きょうは とても さむいです。
wrong: きょうは すこし さむいです。
きょうは あまり さむくないです。
きょうは とても あついです。
items.note: This asks what たいへん means before an adjective: very, とても.
items.sentence: きょうは たいへん さむいです。

items.en: I'll phone a friend this evening.
items.answer: きょうの よる ともだちに でんわします。
wrong: きのうの よる ともだちに でんわしました。
あしたの よる ともだちに でんわします。
きょうの あさ ともだちに でんわします。
items.note: This asks what こんばん means: this evening, きょうの よる.
items.sentence: こんばん ともだちに でんわします。

items.en: I'm free today.
items.answer: きょうは いそがしく ありません。
wrong: きょうは とても いそがしいです。
きょうは しごとが たくさん あります。
きょうは げんきじゃ ありません。
items.note: This asks what ひま means: having free time, not いそがしい.
items.sentence: きょうは ひまです。

items.en: I took a walk in the park this morning.
items.answer: きょうの あさ こうえんを さんぽしました。
wrong: きのうの あさ こうえんを さんぽしました。
きょうの よる こうえんを さんぽしました。
あしたの あさ こうえんを さんぽします。
items.note: This asks what けさ means: this morning, きょうの あさ.
items.sentence: けさ こうえんを さんぽしました。

items.en: My older brother got married the year before last.
items.answer: あには にねんまえに けっこんしました。

wrong.option: あには きょねん けっこんしました。
wrong.why: きょねん is last year, one year ago. おととし is two.

wrong.option: あには さんねんまえに けっこんしました。
wrong.why: さんねんまえ is three years ago. おととし is two.

wrong.option: あには らいねん けっこんします。
wrong.why: らいねん is next year, still to come.

items.note: This asks what おととし means: the year before last, にねんまえ, two years ago.
items.sentence: あには おととし けっこんしました。

items.en: Lots of flowers are blooming in the garden.
items.answer: にわに はなが いっぱい さいて います。

wrong.option: にわに はなが すこし さいて います。
wrong.why: すこし is a few, the opposite of たくさん.

wrong.option: にわには はなが ありません。
wrong.why: This says there are no flowers at all.

wrong.option: にわに きれいな はなが さいて います。
wrong.why: きれい says how they look, not how many there are.

items.note: This asks for another word for たくさん, a lot: いっぱい.
items.sentence: にわに はなが たくさん さいて います。

items.en: Please come and visit again.
items.answer: もう いちど あそびに きて ください。

wrong.option: はじめて あそびに きて ください。
wrong.why: はじめて is for the first time. また is again.

wrong.option: あとで あそびに いきます。
wrong.why: This says you will go later. また asks them to come again.

wrong.option: もう こないで ください。
wrong.why: This asks them not to come any more, the opposite.

items.note: This asks what また means: again, もう いちど.
items.sentence: また あそびに きて ください。

items.en: The next room is noisy.
items.answer: となりの へやの おとが おおきいです。

wrong.option: となりの へやは しずかです。
wrong.why: しずか is quiet, the opposite of うるさい.

wrong.option: となりの へやは せまいです。
wrong.why: せまい is about size, not noise.

wrong.option: となりの へやは くらいです。
wrong.why: くらい is dark: about light, not noise.

items.note: This asks what うるさい means: noisy, with loud sounds, おとが おおきい.
items.sentence: となりの へやが うるさいです。

items.en: I will graduate from university the year after next.
items.answer: わたしは らいねんの つぎの とし だいがくを でます。

wrong.option: わたしは らいねん だいがくを でます。
wrong.why: らいねん is next year. さらいねん is the year after that.

wrong.option: わたしは おととし だいがくを でました。
wrong.why: おととし is two years ago, in the past.

wrong.option: わたしは ことし だいがくを でます。
wrong.why: ことし is this year.

items.note: This asks what さらいねん means: the year after next, らいねんの つぎの とし.
items.sentence: わたしは さらいねん だいがくを でます。

items.en: Yamada is the tallest in this class.
items.answer: この クラスに やまださんより せが たかい ひとは いません。

wrong.option: この クラスに やまださんより せが ひくい ひとは いません。
wrong.why: This would make やまださん the shortest.

wrong.option: この クラスで やまださんは いちばん せが ひくいです。
wrong.why: This is the opposite: the shortest.

wrong.option: この クラスには やまださんと おなじぐらいの ひとが たくさん います。
wrong.why: いちばん says nobody is taller. This says many are about the same.

items.note: This asks for another way to say the tallest: nobody is taller than やまださん, やまださんより たかい ひとは いない.
items.sentence: この クラスで やまださんが いちばん せが たかいです。

items.en: I have no brothers or sisters.
items.answer: わたしには あにも あねも おとうとも いもうとも いません。

wrong.option: わたしには ともだちが いません。
wrong.why: ともだち are friends. きょうだい are brothers and sisters.

wrong.option: わたしには あにが ひとり います。
wrong.why: This says you have one older brother.

wrong.option: わたしには こどもが いません。
wrong.why: こども are children. きょうだい are brothers and sisters.

items.note: This asks what きょうだい means: brothers and sisters, あに, あね, おとうと and いもうと.
items.sentence: わたしには きょうだいが いません。

items.en: My older sister is a student at the same school as me.
items.answer: わたしも あねも その がっこうの がくせいです。

wrong.option: あねは わたしの がっこうの せんせいです。
wrong.why: This makes your sister a teacher there, not a student.

wrong.option: あねと わたしは ちがう がっこうの がくせいです。
wrong.why: ちがう is different, the opposite of おなじ.

wrong.option: あねは わたしの がっこうの そばに すんで います。
wrong.why: This says where she lives, not where she studies.

items.note: This asks what おなじ がっこう means: you both study at that school, わたしも あねも.
items.sentence: あねは わたしと おなじ がっこうの がくせいです。

items.en: Excuse me, may I have some water?
items.note: This asks how みず is written: 水. 氷 is こおり (ice), 木 is き (a tree) and 火 is ひ (fire).
items.sentence: すみません、__みず__を ください。

items.en: Please go out through the door on the right.

wrong.why: 左 is ひだり, the other side. 右 has 口 at the bottom; 左 has 工.
石 is いし, a stone.
名 is the な of なまえ (a name).

items.note: This asks how みぎ is written: 右. Its partner 左 (ひだり) differs only at the bottom.
items.sentence: __みぎ__の ドアから でて ください。

items.en: Please write with this ballpoint pen.

wrong.why: The last letter is ン (n). ソ (so) looks like it, but its long stroke goes down from the top.
ぼ has a dakuten, so it is ボ. ポ, with the small circle, is ぽ.
る is ル. レ is れ.

items.note: This asks how ぼーるぺん is written: ボールペン. Words from other languages are written in katakana.
items.sentence: この __ぼーるぺん__で かいて ください。

items.en: Please write your name here.

wrong.why: The first kanji is 名 (な). 各 (かく, each) has a different top.
The second kanji is 前 (まえ). 部 is ぶ, a part or a club.
Neither kanji is right: なまえ is 名 and 前.

items.note: This asks how なまえ is written: 名前, the な of 名 and the まえ of 前.
items.sentence: ここに __なまえ__を かいて ください。

items.en: I go to work by train every morning.

wrong.why: 雷 is かみなり, thunder: 田 under the rain. 電 has 申 under the rain, with a long tail.
The second kanji is 車 (くるま). 東 is ひがし, east.
Both kanji are look-alikes. でんしゃ is 電, with 申 under the rain, and 車.

items.note: This asks how でんしゃ is written: 電車. 電 is electricity, and 車 a vehicle.
items.sentence: まいあさ __でんしゃ__で かいしゃへ いきます。

items.en: I bought new shoes yesterday.

wrong.why: 親しい is したしい, close (as friends are). 親 has 見 on the right; 新 has 斤.
The kanji is right, but あたらしい keeps しい after it: 新しい.
薪 is たきぎ, firewood: 新 with grass on top. There is no such word.

items.note: This asks how あたらしい is written: 新しい, with しい after the kanji.
items.sentence: きのう __あたらしい__ くつを かいました。

items.en: I climbed a high mountain.
items.note: This asks how やま, a mountain, is written: 山. 川 is a river, 木 a tree and 森 a forest.
items.sentence: たかい __やま__に のぼりました。

items.en: Pretty flowers are blooming in the park.
items.note: This asks how はな, a flower, is written: 花. 茶 is tea, 英 is the えい of えいご, and 化 means to change.
items.sentence: こうえんに きれいな __はな__が さいて います。

items.en: Please open your mouth wide.
items.note: This asks how くち, a mouth, is written: 口. 日 is the sun or a day, 田 a rice field, and 回 a time, as in いっかい.
items.sentence: __くち__を おおきく あけて ください。

items.en: My older brother is a doctor.
items.note: This asks how あに, my older brother, is written: 兄. 弟 is a younger brother, 姉 an older sister and 妹 a younger sister.
items.sentence: わたしの __あに__は いしゃです。

items.en: Your eyes are red.

wrong.why: 自 is the じ of じぶん (yourself): 目 with a short stroke on top.
日 is the sun or a day: one line inside, not two.
月 is the moon or a month: its left side is a long curve.

items.note: This asks how め, an eye, is written: 目, a box with two lines inside.
items.sentence: __め__が あかいですね。

items.en: Who is the person over there?

wrong.why: 入 means to enter. It mirrors 人: in 入 the stroke on the right is the long one.
八 is eight: two strokes that do not touch.
大 means big: 人 with a line across it.

items.note: This asks how ひと, a person, is written: 人.
items.sentence: あそこに いる __ひと__は だれですか。

items.en: I watch the news on TV every evening.

wrong.why: び has a dakuten, so it is ビ. ピ, with the small circle, is ぴ.
て has no dakuten: テ. デ is で.
び has a dakuten: ビ. ヒ is ひ.

items.note: This asks how てれび is written. Words from other languages are written in katakana: テレビ.
items.sentence: まいばん __てれび__で ニュースを みます。

items.en: I have a headache, so I will stay home from school.

wrong.why: 体 is the body. 休 has a person beside a tree.
林 is a wood: two trees and no person.
木 is a tree. やすむ adds a person beside it: 休.

items.note: This asks how やすみます is written: 休みます, a person resting by a tree.
items.sentence: あたまが いたいですから、がっこうを __やすみます__。

items.en: I borrowed three books from the library.

wrong.why: 木 is a tree. 本 is a tree with a short line near its foot.
末 is the end: a tree with a long line on top. 本 has its short line near the bottom.
未 is not yet: a tree with a short line on top. 本 has its short line near the bottom.

items.note: This asks how ほん, a book, is written: 本, a tree with a short line near its foot.
items.sentence: としょかんで __ほん__を 3さつ かりました。

items.en: The cat has big ears.

wrong.why: 取 means to take: 耳 with a hand beside it.
早 means early: the sun over a cross.
自 is the じ of じぶん. 耳 has a long stroke out to the right at the bottom.

items.note: This asks how みみ, an ear, is written: 耳.
items.sentence: ねこの __みみ__は おおきいですね。

items.en: Let's meet at the station at three in the afternoon.

wrong.why: 牛 is a cow: its middle line goes through the top. In 午 it does not.
役 is a role, read やく. 後 has 幺 and 夂 on the right.
Neither kanji is right: ごご is 午, with no line through the top, and 後.

items.note: This asks how ごご, the afternoon, is written: 午後. 午 is noon, and 後 after.
items.sentence: __ごご__ さんじに えきで あいましょう。

items.en: I talk with my friends in Japanese.

wrong.why: 語 is the ご of にほんご, a language. 話 has 舌, the tongue, on the right.
詰 means to pack. 話 has 舌 on the right, not 吉.
話 already says はな, so only します follows: 話します.

items.note: This asks how はなします is written: 話します, with 舌, the tongue, on the right.
items.sentence: ともだちと にほんごで __はなします__。

items.en: Until what time is the library open?

wrong.why: 官 is an official, with no 食 on the left. A building such as a library is 館.
区 is a ward of a city. と is 図.
昼 is noon. しょ is 書, writing.

items.note: This asks how としょかん, a library, is written: 図書館, a building (館) of books (図書).
items.sentence: __としょかん__は なんじまで あいて いますか。

items.en: There's no money in my wallet.
items.note: This asks how おかね, money, is written: お金. お茶 is tea, お米 rice and お酒 sake.
items.sentence: さいふに __おかね__が ありません。

items.en: The wind is strong today, isn't it?
items.note: This asks how かぜ, the wind, is written: 風. 雨 is rain, 雪 snow and 雲 a cloud.
items.sentence: きょうは __かぜ__が つよいですね。

items.en: I'm waiting in front of the station.
items.note: This asks how まえ, in front, is written: 前. 後 is behind or after, 上 above and 中 inside.
items.sentence: えきの __まえ__で まって います。

items.en: I live in a new house.
items.note: This asks how いえ, a house, is written: 家. 店 is a shop, 駅 a station and 寺 a temple.
items.sentence: あたらしい __いえ__に すんで います。

items.en: Please go straight along this road.

wrong.why: 首 is the neck. 道 has 首 inside, with a long stroke running under it.
通 means to pass through. Its inside is different: not 首.
近 means near: 斤 inside, not 首.

items.note: This asks how みち, a road, is written: 道, 首 with a long stroke under it.
items.sentence: この __みち__を まっすぐ いって ください。

items.en: I went to Kyoto in the autumn.

wrong.why: 科 is a subject of study. 秋 has 火, fire, on the right.
私 is わたし: 禾 with ム on the right.
和 means Japanese style: 禾 with 口 on the right.

items.note: This asks how あき, autumn, is written: 秋, 禾 with 火 on the right.
items.sentence: __あき__に きょうとへ いきました。

items.en: My father reads the newspaper every morning.

wrong.why: 間 means between: 門 with 日 inside. 聞 has 耳, an ear, inside.
親 is a parent. しん here is 新, new.
問 is a question: 門 with 口 inside. 聞 has 耳 inside.

items.note: This asks how しんぶん is written: 新聞, new (新) things heard (聞).
items.sentence: ちちは まいあさ __しんぶん__を よみます。

items.en: I saw a film on Sunday.

wrong.why: 英 is the えい of えいご. In えいが it is 映, with 日 on the left.
面 is a face or a surface. が is 画, a picture.
央 is the middle. 映 adds 日 on its left.

items.note: This asks how えいが, a film, is written: 映画, a picture (画) that is shown (映).
items.sentence: にちようびに __えいが__を みました。

items.en: I'll walk to the station.

wrong.why: 走 is to run, はしる. あるく is 歩.
少 is a little, すこし. 歩 has 止 on top.
止 is to stop, とまる. 歩 adds a part under it.

items.note: This asks how あるきます is written: 歩きます.
items.sentence: えきまで __あるきます__。

items.en: Please turn off the light in the room.

wrong.why: 汽 is steam: 気 with water on the left. き here is 気.
雷 is thunder: 田 under the rain. 電 has 申 under the rain.
Neither kanji is right: でんき is 電 and 気.

items.note: This asks how でんき, electricity or a light, is written: 電気.
items.sentence: へやの __でんき__を けして ください。

items.en: The hospital is in front of the station.

wrong.why: 完 means complete. いん here is 院, a building, with ⻖ on the left.
疲 means tired. びょう is 病, with 丙 inside the frame.
Neither kanji is right: びょういん is 病 and 院.

items.note: This asks how びょういん, a hospital, is written: 病院, a building (院) for illness (病).
items.sentence: __びょういん__は えきの まえに あります。

items.en: I study Japanese every evening.

wrong.why: 免 means to excuse. 勉 adds 力, strength, on the right.
弱 is weak, the opposite of 強.
勤 is to work at a job. べん is 勉.

items.note: This asks how べんきょう, study, is written: 勉強.
items.sentence: まいばん にほんごを __べんきょう__します。

items.en: I get up at six every morning.

wrong.why: 記 means to write down, with 言 on the left. 起 has 走 on the left.
走 is to run. 起 has 走 on the left with 己 beside it.
おきます keeps き after the kanji: 起きます.

items.note: This asks how おきます is written: 起きます.
items.sentence: まいあさ 6じに __おきます__。

items.en: It's cold outside.
items.note: This asks how そと, outside, is written: 外. 中 is inside, 上 above and 下 below.
items.sentence: __そと__は さむいですよ。

items.en: I went to bed late at night.
items.note: This asks how よる, night, is written: 夜. 夕 is early evening, 晩 the evening, and 昨 means last, as in last night.
items.sentence: __よる__ おそく ねました。

items.en: Let's meet on Friday.
items.note: This asks how きんようび, Friday, is written: 金曜日. 土曜日 is Saturday, 木曜日 Thursday and 月曜日 Monday.
items.sentence: __きんようび__に あいましょう。

items.en: Who is that woman?
items.note: This asks how おんな, a woman, is written: 女. 男 is a man, 子 a child and 母 a mother.
items.sentence: あの __おんな__の ひとは だれですか。

items.en: Please wait a moment.

wrong.why: 小 is small, as in ちいさい. 少 has a slanting stroke at the bottom.
多 is many, as in おおい: the opposite.
すこし keeps only し after the kanji: 少し.

items.note: This asks how すこし, a little, is written: 少し.
items.sentence: __すこし__ まって ください。

items.en: Shall we eat together?

wrong.why: 飲 is to drink, のむ: 欠 on the right. 飯 has 反.
館 is a building, as in としょかん: 官 on the right.
版 is a printing block: 片 on the left. 飯 has 食 on the left.

items.note: This asks how ごはん, a meal or rice, is written: ご飯, with 食, food, on the left.
items.sentence: いっしょに __ごはん__を たべませんか。

items.en: The bread at this shop is cheap.

wrong.why: 女 is a woman. 安 adds a roof on top.
字 is a letter: 子 under the roof, not 女.
やすい keeps only い after the kanji: 安い.

items.note: This asks how やすい, cheap, is written: 安い, 女 under a roof.
items.sentence: この みせの パンは __やすい__です。

items.en: I'm meeting a friend at the station.

wrong.why: 今 is いま, now. 会 has 云 under its roof.
公 means public. 会 has a roof on top.
あいます keeps い after the kanji: 会います.

items.note: This asks how あいます, to meet someone, is written: 会います.
items.sentence: えきで ともだちに __あいます__。

items.en: It is very cold today.

wrong.why: さむい keeps only い after the kanji: 寒い.
