暑い is あつい, hot: the opposite.
実 is a fruit or a seed. Its inside is different from 寒.

items.note: This asks how さむい, cold (for weather), is written: 寒い.
items.sentence: きょうは とても __さむい__です。

items.en: I drink coffee every morning.

wrong.why: 飯 is cooked rice, as in ごはん: 反 on the right, not 欠.
食 is to eat, たべる. のむ is 飲, with 欠 on the right.
のみます keeps み after the kanji: 飲みます.

items.note: This asks how のみます is written: 飲みます, with 欠 on the right.
items.sentence: まいあさ コーヒーを __のみます__。

items.en: I asked the teacher a question.

wrong.why: 間 is between: 日 inside the gate. 問 has 口 inside.
貿 is trade. 質 has two 斤 on top.
門 is a gate. A question is 問, with 口 inside the gate.

items.note: This asks how しつもん, a question, is written: 質問, with 口, a mouth, inside the gate.
items.sentence: せんせいに __しつもん__を しました。

items.en: I wash my hands before eating.

wrong.why: 先 is さき, ahead. 洗 adds water on the left.
流 means to flow. 洗 has 先 on the right.
あらいます keeps only います after the kanji: 洗います.

items.note: This asks how あらいます, to wash, is written: 洗います, water beside 先.
items.sentence: ごはんの まえに てを __あらいます__。

items.en: I like cats.

wrong.why: 如 means like or as: 口 on the right, not 子.
すき keeps only き after the kanji: 好き.
姉 is an older sister: 市 on the right, not 子.

items.note: This asks how すき is written: 好き, 女 beside 子.
items.sentence: わたしは ねこが __すき__です。

items.en: I wrote a letter to my mother.
items.note: This asks how てがみ, a letter, is written: 手紙, hand and paper. 切手 is a stamp, 手帳 a notebook and 手袋 gloves.
items.sentence: ははに __てがみ__を かきました。

items.en: What food do you like?
items.note: This asks how たべもの, food, is written: 食べ物. 飲み物 is a drink, 着物 a kimono and 果物 fruit.
items.sentence: すきな __たべもの__は なんですか。

items.en: I bought new clothes at the department store.
items.note: This asks how ようふく, Western clothes, is written: 洋服. 和服 is Japanese dress, 洋食 Western food and 衣服 clothing in general, read いふく.
items.sentence: デパートで あたらしい __ようふく__を かいました。

items.en: I came to Japan last year.
items.note: This asks how きょねん, last year, is written: 去年. 今年 is this year, 来年 next year and 毎年 every year.
items.sentence: __きょねん__ にほんへ きました。

items.en: I caught a cold, so I took some medicine.

wrong.why: 楽 is fun, as in たのしい. 薬 adds grass on top.
葉 is a leaf. 薬 has 楽 under the grass.
茶 is tea. 薬 has 楽 under the grass.

items.note: This asks how くすり, medicine, is written: 薬, 楽 under grass (艹).
items.sentence: かぜを ひきましたから、__くすり__を のみました。

items.en: There are fish in the pond in the park.

wrong.why: 地 is the ground, with 土 on the left. 池 has water on the left.
他 means other, with a person on the left.
治 is to cure: water on the left, but 台 on the right.

items.note: This asks how いけ, a pond, is written: 池, with water (氵) on the left.
items.sentence: こうえんの __いけ__に さかなが います。

items.en: Please sing a song you like.

wrong.why: 欠 means lacking. 歌 has 哥 on its left.
哥 is only part of this kanji. 歌 adds 欠 on the right.
欲 means to want, with 谷 on the left.

items.note: This asks how うた, a song, is written: 歌.
items.sentence: すきな __うた__を うたって ください。

items.en: My father works for a car company.

wrong.why: 自転車 is じてんしゃ, a bicycle: 転, turning, not 動, moving.
働 is to work, with a person on the left. どう here is 動, moving.
者 is a person. しゃ here is 車, a vehicle.

items.note: This asks how じどうしゃ, a car, is written: 自動車, a vehicle (車) that moves (動) by itself (自).
items.sentence: ちちは __じどうしゃ__の かいしゃで はたらいて います。

items.en: The station is close to here.

wrong.why: 遠い is とおい, far: the opposite.
ちかい keeps only い after the kanji: 近い.
返 is to return: 反 inside, not 斤.

items.note: This asks how ちかい, near, is written: 近い.
items.sentence: えきは ここから __ちかい__です。

items.en: This bag is very heavy.

wrong.why: 軽い is かるい, light: the opposite.
動 is to move: 重 with 力 on the right.
おもい keeps only い after the kanji: 重い.

items.note: This asks how おもい, heavy, is written: 重い.
items.sentence: この かばんは とても __おもい__です。

items.en: The teacher teaches Japanese.

wrong.why: 孝 is respect for parents. 教 adds 攵 on the right.
救 is to rescue: 求 on the left. 教 has 孝 on the left.
おしえます keeps only えます after the kanji: 教えます.

items.note: This asks how おしえます, to teach, is written: 教えます.
items.sentence: せんせいが にほんごを __おしえます__。

items.en: I borrow books from the library.

wrong.why: 貸 is かす, to lend: the other way round.
措 has a hand (扌) on the left. 借 has a person (亻).
昔 is long ago. 借 adds a person on the left.

items.note: This asks how かります, to borrow, is written: 借ります, a person beside 昔.
items.sentence: としょかんで ほんを __かります__。

items.en: My older brother works at a bank.

wrong.why: 動 is to move. 働 adds a person on the left.
はたらいて keeps only いて after the kanji: 働いて.
億 is a hundred million: 意 beside a person.

items.note: This asks how はたらいて is written: 働いて, a person (亻) beside 動.
items.sentence: あには ぎんこうで __はたらいて__ います。

items.en: My older brother plays the guitar.

wrong.why: ぎ has a dakuten: ギ.
た has no dakuten: タ.
たー is long, so it ends with ー: ター.

items.note: This asks how ぎたー is written. Words from other languages are written in katakana: ギター.
items.sentence: あには __ぎたー__を ひきます。

items.en: I'll wear a red skirt.

wrong.why: す is ス. ヌ, with a crossing stroke, is ぬ.
と has no dakuten: ト.
かー is long, so it is followed by ー: カー.

items.note: This asks how すかーと, a skirt, is written: スカート.
items.sentence: あかい __すかーと__を はきます。

items.en: There is a hotel in front of the station.

wrong.why: る is ル. レ is れ.
ほ has no small circle: ホ.
て has no dakuten: テ.

items.note: This asks how ほてる, a hotel, is written: ホテル.
items.sentence: えきの まえに __ほてる__が あります。

items.en: I went from the station by taxi.

wrong.why: く is ク. ケ is け.
し is シ, its strokes rising from the left. ツ is つ.
た has no dakuten: タ.

items.note: This asks how たくしー, a taxi, is written: タクシー.
items.sentence: えきから __たくしー__で いきました。

items.en: I eat soup with a spoon.

wrong.why: す is ス. ヌ, with a crossing stroke, is ぬ.
ぷ has the small circle: プ. ブ is ぶ.
The last letter is ン. ソ is そ.

items.note: This asks how すぷーん, a spoon, is written: スプーン.
items.sentence: __すぷーん__で スープを のみます。

items.en: My father wears a tie every day.

wrong.why: く is ク. ケ is け.
た has no dakuten: タ.
The order is ね・く・た・い: ネクタイ.

items.note: This asks how ねくたい, a necktie, is written: ネクタイ.
items.sentence: ちちは まいにち __ねくたい__を します。

items.en: There is a handkerchief in my pocket.

wrong.why: ん is ン. ソ is そ.
ち is チ. テ is て.
か has no dakuten: カ.

items.note: This asks how はんかち, a handkerchief, is written: ハンカチ.
items.sentence: ポケットに __はんかち__が あります。

items.en: I'll take the lift to the fifth floor.

wrong.why: べ has a dakuten, not the small circle: ベ.
Both long sounds need ー: ベー and ター.
れ is レ. ル is る.

items.note: This asks how えれべーたー, a lift, is written: エレベーター.
items.sentence: __えれべーたー__で 5かいへ いきます。

items.en: I get on the bus at the station.

wrong.why: 来 is くる, to come.
東 is east, ひがし.
垂 means to hang down.

items.note: This asks how のります, to get on, is written: 乗ります.
items.sentence: えきから バスに __のります__。

items.en: I open the door and go into the room.

wrong.why: 人 is a person. 入 is its mirror: the stroke on the right is the long one.
八 is eight: two strokes that do not touch.
込 is to be crowded: 入 inside ⻌. はいる on its own is 入.

items.note: This asks how はいります, to go in, is written: 入ります.
items.sentence: ドアを あけて、へやに __はいります__。

items.en: I make a cake with my mother.

wrong.why: 昨 means last, as in last night: 日 on the left. 作 has a person on the left.
つくります keeps only ります after the kanji: 作ります.
仕 means to serve: 士 on the right. 作 has 乍.

items.note: This asks how つくります, to make, is written: 作ります.
items.sentence: ははと いっしょに ケーキを __つくります__。

items.en: I bought a white shirt.

wrong.why: つ is ツ, its strokes coming down from the top. シ is し.
し is シ, its strokes rising from the left. ツ is つ.
つ is ツ, with two short strokes. ソ, with one, is そ.

items.note: This asks how しゃつ, a shirt, is written: シャツ. シ and ツ look alike: シ's short strokes sit on the left, ツ's along the top.
items.sentence: しろい __しゃつ__を かいました。

items.en: I'm having a party at home on Saturday.

wrong.why: ぱ has the small circle: パ. バ is ば.
てぃ is テ with a small ィ, not a full イ.
てぃ is テ with a small ィ. チ is ち.

items.note: This asks how ぱーてぃー, a party, is written: パーティー, with a small ィ.
items.sentence: どようびに うちで __ぱーてぃー__を します。

items.en: This shop sells vegetables.

wrong.why: 買 is かう, to buy: the other way round.
うって keeps って after the kanji: 売って.
読 is よむ, to read: 言 on the left of 売.

items.note: This asks how うって is written: 売って, to sell. 売 and 買 look alike, and mean opposite things.
items.sentence: この みせは やさいを __うって__ います。

question-mo-negative.label: なにも・だれも・どこも

question-ka-indefinite.label: なにか・だれか・どこか
